Join the Shilajitness Affiliate Program!

Brand Introduction:

Shilajitness is dedicated to harnessing the power of Shilajit, a potent natural supplement sourced from the pristine Himalayas. Our mission is to promote holistic wellness through high-quality, authentic products that enhance health and vitality. We believe in empowering individuals to lead healthier lives while sharing the benefits of this remarkable supplement with the world.

Product Description:

Shilajit is a mineral-rich resin known for its numerous health benefits, including increased energy, enhanced cognitive function, improved endurance, and overall wellness support. Our Shilajit is carefully sourced and processed to retain its natural potency, making it a premium choice for those seeking a natural supplement to boost their health.

Unique Selling Point (USP):

What sets Shilajitness apart is our commitment to quality and authenticity. We provide 100% pure Shilajit in its natural resin form, ensuring maximum efficacy and absorption. Our product undergoes rigorous quality testing to guarantee it meets the highest health standards, making it a trusted choice for health-conscious consumers.

Payment Terms:

  • Commission Structure: Affiliates earn a commission on every sale generated through their unique referral link.
  • Payout Options: Payments are made through flexible options, including PayPal, bank transfer, and debit card.
  • Payment Schedule: Commissions are paid monthly, ensuring timely access to your earnings.

Other Information:

  • User-Friendly Tools: Affiliates gain access to a variety of marketing materials, including banners, social media content, and email templates, to effectively promote Shilajitness.
  • Real-Time Tracking: Our intuitive affiliate dashboard allows you to monitor your clicks, conversions, and earnings in real-time.
  • Ongoing Support: Our dedicated affiliate support team is available to assist you with any questions or marketing strategies to help you succeed.

Who Can Join?

Whether you’re a health enthusiast, influencer, blogger, or anyone passionate about natural wellness, our affiliate program is open to you!

How to Get Started?

  1. Sign Up: Join our affiliate program by completing a simple registration form.
  2. Promote: Share your unique referral link through your social media, website, or blog.
  3. Earn: Receive commissions on sales generated through your referrals!

Join Us Today!

Become a part of the Shilajitness family and start your journey towards earning rewards while promoting natural health solutions. Sign up now and make a difference in your community!

Shilajitness Affiliate Program Terms and Conditions

Last Updated: October 27, 2024

Welcome to the Shilajitness Affiliate Program, powered by UpPromote. By joining our affiliate program, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please review them carefully.

1. Affiliate Enrollment

  • Enrollment in the Shilajitness Affiliate Program is open to approved applicants through our UpPromote registration page.
  • Acceptance is at Shilajitness's discretion, and we reserve the right to decline any application that does not align with our brand standards.

2. Commission Structure

  • Affiliates earn commissions based on sales generated through unique referral links or discount codes provided upon approval.
  • Standard Commission Rate: 10% per sale.
  • Bonus Commissions: Shilajitness may offer bonus commissions for specific promotions or milestones, which will be communicated in advance.
  • Commission calculations are based on net sales (after discounts, returns, and other applicable adjustments).

3. Discount Code Usage

  • Affiliates will receive unique discount codes to share with their audience, incentivizing purchases through their referral link.
  • Discount codes are valid only on the Shilajitness website and must be used following the guidelines outlined in the affiliate dashboard.
  • Misuse of discount codes, such as self-purchases or unauthorized sharing, may result in termination from the program.

4. Payout Terms

  • Payment Methods: Affiliates can receive payouts via:
    • PayPal
    • Bank Transfer
    • Debit Card
  • Minimum Threshold: Affiliates must reach a minimum payout threshold of €20 before a commission is issued.
  • Payout Schedule: Payments are made monthly, within 31 days of the end of each payout period.

5. Promotional Guidelines

  • Affiliates may use provided Shilajitness promotional materials, including logos, images, and banners.
  • Affiliates are required to represent Shilajitness products honestly and may not make false or misleading claims.

6. Affiliate Dashboard

  • UpPromote provides each affiliate with a dashboard where they can track referrals, earnings, and other performance metrics.
  • It is the affiliate's responsibility to monitor their dashboard and address any discrepancies with Shilajitness within 31 days.

7. Fraud Prevention

  • Shilajitness has a zero-tolerance policy for affiliate fraud, which includes, but is not limited to, self-referrals, false advertising, and fake referrals.
  • Affiliates found to be engaging in fraudulent activity will be immediately removed from the program, and any unpaid commissions will be forfeited.

8. Term and Termination

  • The affiliate agreement begins upon acceptance and will continue unless terminated by either party.
  • Shilajitness reserves the right to terminate any affiliate's participation at any time, with or without cause.
  • Upon termination, affiliates will no longer have access to their affiliate dashboard or tracking links.

9. Modifications to Terms

  • Shilajitness reserves the right to update or modify these terms at any time.
  • Affiliates will be notified of changes via email or through the UpPromote platform. Continued participation constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.

10. Intellectual Property

  • Shilajitness grants affiliates a limited, non-exclusive, revocable license to use Shilajitness trademarks and promotional materials solely for purposes of promoting Shilajitness products within the program's guidelines.
  • Unauthorized use of Shilajitness intellectual property is prohibited.

11. Limitation of Liability

  • Shilajitness is not liable for any indirect, special, incidental, or consequential damages arising from participation in the affiliate program.
  • Shilajitness’s liability is limited to the total amount of commissions paid to the affiliate.

12. Governing Law

  • These terms are governed by the laws of Portugal.
